verdict.rationale: Pigment documents variance analysis on the budgeting platform and says users can "understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps" (pigment-docs-8). That is its own capability aimed at explaining variances, not just detecting them. The Analyst Agent claims to monitor the business and "uncover what matters" (pigment-docs-6), and users can ask business questions and get grounded answers (pigment-docs-2). However, the reasons may be supplied by people: the demo shows tagging HR to respond in a thread (pigment-docs-9), and no evidence shows the platform itself decomposing or explaining a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance. Missing for 10: explicit automated variance-driver decomposition or explanation, a documented AI-generated variance narrative, period-over-period examples, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
